items.source: This interface sets values on a PreparedStatement provided by the JdbcTemplate class, for each of a number of updates in a batch using the same SQL. Implementations are responsible for setting any necessary parameters. SQL with placeholders will already have been supplied.
items.translation: 该接口为 JdbcTemplate 类提供的 PreparedStatement 设置值，用于使用相同的 SQL 对一批更新中的每一个进行设置。实现类负责设置任何必要的参数。带有占位符的 SQL 语句将已提供。

items.source: Implementations do not need to concern themselves with SQLExceptions that may be thrown from operations they attempt. The JdbcTemplate class will catch and handle SQLExceptions appropriately.
items.translation: 实现无需关心从它们尝试执行的操作中可能抛出的 SQLException。JdbcTemplate 类将捕获并适当处理这些 SQLException。

items.source: Return the size of the batch.
Set parameter values on the given PreparedStatement.
items.translation: 在指定的 PreparedStatement 上设置参数值。

items.source: the number of statements in the batch
SQLException - if an SQLException is encountered (i.e. there is no need to catch SQLException)
items.translation: SQLException - 如果遇到 SQLException（即无需捕获 SQLException）

items.source: ps - the PreparedStatement to invoke setter methods on
items.translation: ps - 用于调用 setter 方法的 PreparedStatement

items.source: i - index of the statement we're issuing in the batch, starting from 0
items.translation: - 我们在批处理中发出的语句的索引，从 0 开始
